ValidationRule.description: Public Id must be C or L plus a UUID v4, or a Contact or Lead Id from a legacy link (ADR 0002). Checked only on insert or change. The legacy-link setting is enforced by the existence check and the batch.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Public_Id__c)), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Public_Id__c)), NOT(REGEX(Public_Id__c, "[CL][0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-4[0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}")), NOT(REGEX(Public_Id__c, "(003|00Q)[a-zA-Z0-9]{12}([a-zA-Z0-9]{3})?")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Public Id must be C or L followed by a Public Id, or a Contact or Lead record Id.
